transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Mara, the Digital Producer. Before we lock the livestream production package for the festival's live fan Q&A, I'd like to run our routine preflight meeting. Can I get the technical, talent, and sponsorship leads to report any confirmed constraints they have so I can record everything and finalize the package?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Hi Mara. I have a confirmed technical constraint to report. During today's platform latency test, I confirmed that audience questions must run through a moderated queue with a 30-second delay. Direct audience-to-guest questions would not be safely controllable on this platform. I haven't entered this result in the production brief yet, but it needs to be factored into the locked package.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Hi Mara. I have a confirmed talent constraint to report. I spoke with the featured guest's agent this morning, and the guest is only available from 7:15 PM through 7:45 PM inclusive, due to a separate appearance. I haven't updated the shared run-of-show yet, but this needs to be factored into the locked package since the current draft has the featured guest segment starting at 7:00 PM.
